headline: A radio stays low in the next room.
body: The voice is traffic, then a pause that is only tape. Light has moved one pane to the left since the last note. We do not turn it up.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: high, washed, warmer than the date

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: radio behind a wall, no name on the dial

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: one pane further along the desk edge
